description: Renovate preset for a repository that calls the workflows of klconsultancy/workflows (extends: github>klconsultancy/workflows:shared-workflows). Their pin moves in a pull request of its own, which waits for review: release-please.yml and renovate.yml only run on main, so the repository's checks never run a change to them; a broken one would land in every repository at once. A repository that calls only workflows its checks do run (pr-title, python-uv, home-assistant, shell, zizmor, claude-review) may let it automerge, with a rule of its own after this preset: {"matchPackageNames": ["klconsultancy/workflows"], "automerge": true}. Rules of the repository come after this preset's, so a rule that groups all actions must leave this pin out ("matchPackageNames": ["!klconsultancy/workflows"]), or the actions group waits for review with it.
